events.title: 크리스털 팰리스 sign Italy midfielder Attilio Lombardo from 유벤투스 for £1.6million.
Footballers Bruce Grobbelaar , Hans Segers and John Fashanu , along with a Thai businessman, are cleared of match-fixing at Winchester Crown Court .
Graeme Le Saux returns to 첼시 after more than four years at 블랙번 로버스 in a £5million deal – a national record for a defender.

반즐리's first top flight game ends in a 2–1 home defeat by 웨스트햄 유나이티드. 코번트리 시티, who narrowly survived last season, pulled off a major surprise by defeating FA Cup holders 첼시 3–2 at Highfield Road . Despite Alan Shearer's absence, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 beat 셰필드 웬즈데이 2–1 at home as 케니 달글리시 continues his quest to try to become the first manager to win the English top division title at three different clubs.
맨체스터 유나이티드 match the new national record for a defender when they sign Henning Berg from 블랙번 로버스 for £5million.
레스터 시티 shock 리버풀 with a 2–1 league win at Anfield .
아스널 announce plans to relocate from Highbury due to its sub-40,000 capacity and difficulties for expansion.
PSV 에인트호번 wins the Johan Cruijff Schaal , the annual opening of the new season in the Eredivisie , with a 3–1 win over 로다 JC in the Amsterdam ArenA .
36-year-old Peter Beardsley leaves 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 in a £450,000 move to 볼턴 원더러스 .
첼시 record one of the biggest ever away league wins in the Premier League with a 6–0 victory over 반즐리 at Oakwell .
블랙번 로버스 beat 셰필드 웬즈데이 7–2 in the league at Ewood Park .

The 리버풀 - 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 FA Premier League fixture is cancelled as a mark of respect for the late Diana, Princess of Wales , who died earlier in the day in a 파리 FC car crash. The month-end Premier League table shows 블랙번 로버스 on a hot run of form under their new manager 로이 호지슨 , topping the league on goal difference ahead of defending champions 맨체스터 유나이티드, while 웨스트햄 유나이티드, 첼시 and 아스널 provide the nearest competition. 윔블던, 애스턴 빌라 and 사우샘프턴 occupy the relegation zone, while newly promoted 볼턴 원더러스, 반즐리 (playing top division football for the first time) at 크리스털 팰리스 have all had a decent first month of the season. 노팅엄 포리스트 head the race for a Premier League place as Division One leaders, while 브래드퍼드 시티 occupy second place in a division they had been expected to struggle in. 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 , 스윈던 타운 , 셰필드 유나이티드 and 포츠머스 complete the top six.
